interview.name: Oren
interview.answer: The repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center.

reflections: Oren is willing to help but is forgetful and needs concrete direction.
Rey is organizing the repair drive and gathering the needed items before asking for help.
Nell is responsive and attentive, staying informed about the event details and sharing updates.
Oren is willing to help with practical repair work, though he seems a bit forgetful and prefers clear direction.
Nell is attentive and supportive, keeping track of details and following up on logistics.
Bo and Mina are coordinating the repair drive by assigning concrete tasks and guiding Oren to the right starting point.
Oren is consistently willing to help but needs concrete direction and a clear first task.
Bo and Gus are coordinating the repair drive by delegating specific sourcing and outreach tasks.
Sam is taking ownership of logistics support, especially the tool list and missing supplies.
Oren is consistently helpful but deferential, often waiting for direction before acting.
Gus is coordinating the repair drive and delegating outreach and tool collection clearly.
Sam is taking an organizing role by managing the tool list and helping route next steps when details are fuzzy.
Oren is willing to help, but relies on others for the latest details and concrete next steps.
The repair drive communication is somewhat inconsistent, with the day changing between Sunday and Saturday and people repeating timing requests.
Sam, Gus, and Rosa are coordinating outreach and logistics, while Ira is still catching up on the plan.

events.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—sorry, my memory’s a bit fuzzy. I’m happy to help, just point me to what needs doing.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren. I’m mostly gathering a few things that need fixing, so I’ll point you to the first one when I’ve got it sorted.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Oren: Sounds good, Rey—just let me know when you’re ready and I’ll do my best to help out.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive happening soon — is that the one you meant?
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Oren: Oh, yes — that’s the one I meant, I think. I’m a bit forgetful, but it should be the repair drive soon.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll keep an ear out for the date and details. If you hear anything else, let me know.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Oren: Oh yes, that sounds right — the repair drive soon. Just point me to the first thing that needs fixing, and I’ll do my best.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Mina: Great — can you start with the loose front gate, and I’ll show you anything bigger after that?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll start on the loose front gate now. Just show me where it’s catching, and I’ll do my best.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Oren: Oh good, thanks, Bo — just let me know where to start. I may be a bit fuzzy, but I’m happy to help with the repair drive.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Bo: Sounds good — can you start by pulling together the basic tools and any spare parts people can donate?
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Oren: Absolutely — I’ll gather the basic tools and any spare parts I can find. Just point me to where to bring them, and I’ll get started.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Gus: That’d be great, Oren — please mention we still need volunteers, spare tools, and folks with repair skills. And have them bring any small items that need fixing.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Oren: Oh, absolutely — I’ll mention volunteers, spare tools, and repair skills, and tell folks to bring any small things that need fixing. Just point me to the first place to start.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Gus: Great — start with the folks closest by, then we’ll work outward. I’ll bring a few tools along too.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Sam: I can handle the list and sort out any missing tools for the repair drive. If anything else comes up, just let me know.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Sam — that’s a big help. Just point me to the first thing that needs fixing, and I’ll do my best.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Sam: I’ll start with the tool list and flag any missing pieces, then I’ll point you to the first repair once I’ve got it sorted.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—my memory’s a bit fuzzy, but I’m happy to help. Just point me to the first thing that needs fixing.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet—what’s the current plan for the repair drive?
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Oren: I’m not totally sure on the latest, sorry—my memory’s a bit fuzzy. I think it’s still the repair drive soon, and I can help once someone points me to the first fix.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word as soon as the times are set. We’ll keep the repair drive moving smoothly.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Oren: Thanks, Mina — yes, we could use a hand on Sunday at the community center, especially with setup or checking folks in. If you’re free, I can send the timing details next.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Gus: Sounds good, Oren — send the timing details when you can, and I’ll help spread the word about Sunday at the community center.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Rosa: Thanks, Oren — the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center. If you can help, I can send the timing details and setup info next.
events.speaker: Rosa

prov.value: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Oren: Oh right, Sunday at the community center — thanks for the reminder. Please send the timing details and setup info, and I’ll help where I can.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Rosa: Yes, the repair drive is still on for Saturday. I’m checking the list now, and I’ll let you know what extra hands or tools we need.
events.speaker: Rosa

prov.value: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
